basis: Acquired disease of skeletal muscle; no additional organ involvement applies across this umbrella.
Corneal fragility and joint connective tissue abnormalities define the syndrome; hearing impairment occurs in 30-79%. Skin extensibility alone does not establish damage.
Congenital primary adrenal cortical insufficiency; no evidence of an autoimmune mechanism or common additional organ damage.
Defined by parkinsonian neurologic dysfunction and unilateral body tissue, including muscle, atrophy; scoliosis is reported in fewer than 30%.
Spinal muscular atrophy denotes motor neuron disease; arthrogryposis denotes defining fixed joint contractures. Further subtype information is unavailable.
A refractive disorder of the eye; its transient nature does not remove its primary ocular location.
Visual loss results from visual cortex dysfunction; intrinsic damage to the eye is not established.
Immune dysregulation; villous atrophy 4/6, bronchiectasis 3/5 and autoimmune cytopenias about 53%. Diabetes is a separately diagnosed disease.
Developmental delay and microcephaly define it; dental abnormalities 80-99%, heart malformations 30-79%, myopia 2/4. Kidney abnormalities are annotated below 30%.
Defined by myocardial structural and functional abnormalities; cirrhosis is the underlying separate liver disease, not damage caused by this cardiomyopathy.
A neurodevelopmental disorder with universal developmental delay; obesity in 7/22 does not establish direct endocrine organ damage.
Temporal lobe seizures define the disease; auditory and gastrointestinal seizure manifestations do not indicate damage to ears or gut.
Inherited mineralization disorder affecting bone; dental mineralization defects and premature tooth loss are common, roughly 40-50%, and major diagnostic features.
Localized patellar tendon disease; an autoimmune mechanism is not inherent to this tendinopathy.
Acute myocardial dysfunction defines the disease; stroke and pulmonary edema are uncommon complications.
Sulfate transport metabolic disorder causes skeletal dysplasia and contractures; cleft palate affects 8/12 in supplied data. External ear shape alone adds no otologic damage.
Developmental and intellectual impairment is common across chromosome 11 deletion syndromes; other organ abnormalities depend on the deleted region.
Autoimmune arthritis and skin sclerosis define it; pulmonary fibrosis is annotated 80-99%. GI disease (80-99%) and ocular sicca (30-79%) omitted because of the four-axis cap.
Inherited autoinflammatory vitreoretinal disease causes uveitis, neovascularization and blindness; additional neurologic findings are not established as common.
Defective color perception defines this visual disorder; no additional organ involvement applies across its subtypes.
KCNT1-related frontal lobe epilepsy; associated intellectual impairment is also neurologic. Psychiatric features add no organ axis.
Respiratory ciliary dysfunction causes chronic airway disease and bronchiectasis in 6/6; noncommunicating hydrocephalus also occurs in 6/6.
Inherited surfactant metabolism dysfunction causes alveolar and interstitial lung disease; pulmonary hypertension and developmental delay each occur in only 2/17.
Malignant tumor arising in bone; lung metastases are described, but involvement of at least 30% of all patients is not established by the supplied evidence.
Motor neuron disease with defining muscle atrophy and contractures; lower limb amyotrophy 13/18 and Achilles contractures 10/18. Respiratory impairment is uncommon.
